context_for_next_testing_agent: Design template application feature is fully working. Key findings: 1) POST /api/projects/{id}/apply-design-template updates all slides with template colors (primary for title/quiz/summary, contentBg for content slides), fonts, header styles, and corner radius. 2) Editor has 'Aplicar Tema Visual' button (Palette icon) with data-testid='apply-template-btn' that opens dialog with 6 templates. 3) Clicking a template calls the API and shows success toast. 4) MediaConfigPanel in Agent page (step 5) loads 6 design templates and applies bgConfig based on slide types. 5) Design templates: corporativo, educacional, minimalista, tech, criativo, elegante - each with unique headerStyle (solid/rounded/minimal/neon/gradient/elegant).

POST /api/projects/{id}/apply-design-tem.details: Endpoint accepts designTemplateId, applies to all slides, returns updatedSlides count. Uses fallback template for invalid IDs. Returns 400 for missing ID, 404 for invalid project.

GET /api/agent/design-templates.details: Returns 6 templates with id, name, description, palette (primary/accent/contentBg/text), fonts (heading/body), headerStyle, cornerRadius
